title: LumenCraft
body:
## 🌟 LumenCraft – A Visual Overhaul without Losing Performance

**LumenCraft** is a carefully curated modpack designed to enhance Minecraft’s visual experience while staying true to the original Vanilla style. Instead of replacing the game’s identity, it refines it—adding modern lighting, subtle environmental details, and cleaner visuals that elevate immersion without impacting performance.

This modpack focuses on lightweight, highly optimized improvements, ensuring smooth gameplay even on mid-range or weaker systems. With thoughtful tweaks to textures, atmosphere, and world clarity, **LumenCraft** delivers a fresh and polished look without the heavy cost of full graphic overhauls.

---

### ✨ Features
- **Vanilla-friendly visuals** — Preserves the original Minecraft charm  
- **Lightweight & performance-focused** — Smooth gameplay on most systems  
- **Enhanced lighting & ambience** — More depth and atmosphere  
- **Subtle texture refinements** — Cleaner, sharper visuals without changing the game’s identity  
- **No shaders required** — Visual upgrades work out of the box  

---

### 💡 Perfect For
Players who want a more immersive and visually pleasing Minecraft experience **without** sacrificing performance or deviating too far from classic Vanilla aesthetics.


 **Side note: Don't be surprised if you get an error message saying that re-shaded is not compatible, but that's okay, it still works.**
